ledger: 00:00-00:01: Child reaches into the glass bowl with both hands and picks up 1 red ball while 8 other balls (2 red, 3 green, 3 yellow) remain in the bowl.
00:02-00:04: Child drops the red ball back into the bowl; all 9 balls (3 red, 3 green, 3 yellow) rest visibly inside the bowl.
